title: Mode Collapse of Mean-Field Variational Inference
abstract: arXiv:2510.17063v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mean-field variational inference (MFVI) is a widely used method for approximating high-dimensional probability distributions by product measures. It has been empirically observed that MFVI optimizers often suffer from \emph{mode collapse}. For example, when the target measure $\pi$ is a mixture $\pi = w P_0 + (1 - w) P_1$, the MFVI optimizer tends to place most of its mass near a single component of the mixture. This work provides the first \emph{theoretical} explanation of mode collapse in MFVI. Starting from two-component mixtures, we introduce the notion of \emph{$\varepsilon$-separateness} to quantify the separation of the mixture components. We derive explicit bounds on the mass that any MFVI optimizer assigns to each component, when $P_0$ and $P_1$ are $\varepsilon$-separated for sufficiently small $\varepsilon$. translated_title: 平均场变分推断的众数坍缩
translated_abstract: 平均场变分推断（MFVI）是一种被广泛使用的方法，通过乘积测度来近似高维概率分布。经验上已经观察到，MFVI 优化器经常遭受“众数坍缩”问题。例如，当目标测度 π 是混合分布 π = w P_0 + (1 - w) P_1 时，MFVI 优化器倾向于将其大部分质量集中在混合分布的单个分量附近。这项工作首次为 MFVI 中的众数坍缩提供了理论解释。从两组分混合分布出发，我们引入“ε-分离性”的概念来量化混合分布各分量之间的分离程度。当 P_0 和 P_1 在足够小的 ε 下满足 ε-分离时，我们推导出了任意 MFVI 优化器分配给每个分量的质量的显式界。我们进一步将这一分析扩展到具有多个分量的混合目标分布。我们的结果揭示了……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文首次从理论上解释了平均场变分推断中的众数坍缩现象，通过引入 ε-分离性概念，推导出 MFVI 优化器分配给混合分布各分量质量的显式界，并扩展到多分量混合分布的情形。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first theoretical explanation of mode collapse in mean-field variational inference by introducing the notion of ε-separateness and deriving explicit bounds on the mass that MFVI optimizers assign to each component of a mixture target distribution.
